        label="Deposit Amount (₹)"
        type="number"
        placeholder="e.g. 100000"
        required={true}

        step="1"

        id="annualRate"

edits.replace:
<CalculatorField
        id="principal"
        label={copy.deposit}
        type="number"
        placeholder="e.g. 100000"
        required={true}
        min="0"
        step="1"
        helpText={copy.depositHelp}
      />

      <CalculatorField
        id="annualRate"
        label={copy.rate}
        type="number"
        placeholder="e.g. 7.5"
        required={true}
        min="0"
        step="0.01"
        helpText={copy.rateHelp}
      />

      <CalculatorField
        id="tenureYears"
        label={copy.tenure}
        type="number"
        placeholder="e.g. 5"
        required={true}
        min="0"
        step="0.25"
        helpText={copy.tenureHelp}
      />

      <CalculatorField
        id="compoundingFrequency"
        label={copy.frequency}
        type="number"
        value="4"
        required={true}
        min="1"
        step="1"
        helpText={copy.frequencyHelp}
      />

      <CalculatorActions
        calculateId="calculateBtn"
        resetId="resetBtn"
        copyId="copyBtn"
        showCopy={true}
        calculateText={copy.calculate}
        resetText={copy.reset}
        copyText={copy.copy}
      />
